text: No, the property did not lose 67.7 ha of tree cover after the EUDR cut-off date (31 December 2020). The 67.7 ha loss occurred in 2020, which is *before* the baseline. Between 2021 and 2025, only minor losses (0.4 ha in patches under 0.5 ha) were detected, which are below the minimum event threshold (0.5 ha) and not counted as significant events. The assessment confirms no tree-cover loss events of 0.5 ha or more occurred within the asset after the baseline.
